title: Representation of a successful formula parse
statement: Let $f\in\mathbb{N}$, let $x$ and $r$ be bit strings, and let $\varphi$ be a CNF formula. If parsing $x$ as a formula with fuel $f$ returns $\varphi$ and remainder $r$, then $x$ is the encoding of $\varphi$ followed by $r$.
hypotheses_covered: The formula parser with fuel $f$ returns $\varphi$ and remainder $r$ on input $x$
